definitions.explanation: A white crystalline substance (sodium chloride) used for seasoning and preserving food. An essential cooking ingredient.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{塩|しお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りません→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: This soup doesn't have enough salt.

notes:
{塩|しお} is salt, one of the most fundamental seasonings in Japanese cooking.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {塩|しお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add salt
- ⟦{塩加減|しおかげん}→塩加減：08575_shiokagen⟧: salt seasoning (the right amount of salt)
- ⟦{塩味|しおあじ}→塩味：12106_shioaji⟧: salty flavor
- ⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧: salt-grilled (fish, etc.)
- ⟦{塩|しお}{漬|づ}け→塩漬け：09008_shiozuke⟧: salted/pickled

RELATED ADJECTIVE:
⟦{塩辛|しおから}い→塩辛い：02522_shiokarai⟧ or ⟦しょっぱい→しょっぱい：02493_shoppai⟧: salty (taste)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Salt has spiritual significance in Shinto. ⟦{清|きよ}め→清める：13340_kiyomeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩|しお} (purifying salt) is scattered at funerals and sumo matches. Small piles of ⟦{盛|も}り{塩|じお}→盛り塩：noentry⟧ are placed at shop entrances for good luck.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {塩|しお}: salt
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧: sugar
